subject: [PATCH 2/3] kernfs: allocate the new name outside kernfs_rwsem

2026-09-13.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs_rename_ns function to allocate a duplicate of the new name outside of the kernfs_rwsem write lock. This is done by creating a copy of the new name before taking the lock and freeing it again if the rename operation does not need it. The goal of this change is to prevent a rename operation from entering reclaim while other operations in the hierarchy are waiting behind it, which could lead to deadlocks.
